meta.title: Receiving Decision
meta.flowPosition: after 09 Discrepancy Resolution & Quarantine, before 11 Goods Receipt & Documentation
meta.note: Convergence stage. Backend-authoritative. Everything from Screens 06-09 lands here as one shipment-level decision with a required rationale. Output is an immutable Receiving Decision consumed by Screen 11.

purpose: The learner reviews the consolidated evidence from dock verification, goods inspection, barcode verification, and discrepancy resolution, then submits the shipment-level receiving decision together with a rationale that must cite the evidence that actually drove it.
learningObjectives: Synthesise evidence across four prior stages into one decision
Apply the receiving decision rubric (accept / partial accept / reject) correctly
Write a rationale that cites the specific evidence behind the decision, not a generic statement
Recognise when residual issues (quarantine, reject items) require partial or full rejection

input.note: The runtime consolidates a summary from all four prior stages; the learner does not re-derive it, only reviews and decides.

accept_shipment.when: finalRejectList is empty AND finalQuarantineList is empty AND no unresolved escalations

partial_acceptance.when: finalRejectList is empty AND (finalQuarantineList is non-empty OR escalations were resolved without a reject-level outcome)

reject_shipment.when: finalRejectList is non-empty, OR dockDecision was reject_shipment

supervisor.example: Your rationale should point at what actually happened on this shipment, not restate the checklist.

correctnessModel.authority: Flora Backend (reference logic mirrors the decisionRubric above)
correctnessModel.rationaleQuality: did the cited evidence reference the actual driving items/issues from finalQuarantineList / finalRejectList / escalations, not generic text
penalties: decision matches but rationale cites no real evidence → process gap (low rationale quality even though outcome is correct)
decision does not match the rubric outcome → major error
correctnessModel.evidence: append-only LearnerAction stream (seq, ts, action, target, competencies, result, meta)

completion.rule: Stage completes when a decision is selected, rationale is submitted citing evidence, and the record is handed to Screen 11.
completion.note: Completion is reaching a submitted decision. Correctness (rubric match) and rationale quality are assessed separately.

output.note: The Receiving Decision becomes an immutable part of the simulation attempt. Screen 11 consumes it to determine net accepted quantities and generate the GRN.

shape.evidenceRef: LearnerAction seq range for this stage
